rows._note: Standard Indian residential combined bathroom: WC + sink + shower stall.
Bath area without WC — typical in 3+ bath dwellings as washroom.
Standalone WC. NBC 2016 Part 3 Clause 12.4. Often the smallest wet room.
Single sink default. Dual-sink luxury extension via B-227.
Indian utility room: washing machine + utility sink. Fixture mapping covers sink only; washing-machine connection separate (B-220).

_v2_extension_notes: Future fixtures via B-227: bidet (paired with WC in luxury bathrooms), dual_kitchen_sink, dishwasher_drain, washing_machine_drain, water_purifier_drain. Each new fixture must add a row to kb/plumbing_minimums.json first (trap_arm_max_m + pipe diameter + trap seal), then this profile KB references it. B-234 tracks full registry validator tooling.
_validation_at_runtime: C10 calls validate_plumbing_kbs_compatibility(profiles_kb=this, minimums_kb=plumbing_minimums) at first plan_wet_zones() invocation. Mismatch raises KBVersionMismatchError with orphan-fixture-types listed.
